meta.name: baoyu-diagram
meta.description: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines, illustrative/conceptual diagrams, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks for any kind of technical or conceptual diagram, visualization of a system, process flow, data flow, component relationship, network topology, decision tree, org chart, state machine, or any visual representation of structure/logic/process. Also trigger when the user says "画个图" "画一个架构图" "diagram" "flowchart" "sequence diagram" "draw me a ..." or uploads content and asks to visualize it. Output is always a standalone .svg file.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任何系统或流程自动生成专业深色SVG图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速把复杂结构或流程变成清晰图表
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional dark-themed SVG diagrams from any system or process
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn complex structures or processes into clear diagrams

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按你的描述画深色主题的 SVG 图,覆盖架构图、流程图、时序图、思维导图等多种类型,产出单个 .svg 文件,并另存一张 @2x PNG,最后把两个文件给你。
howto.when: 当你要求画架构图、流程图、时序图等结构或流程可视化,或说“画个图”“draw me a ...”、上传内容要求可视化时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一张微服务架构图
say.note: 输出 .svg 和 @2x PNG 两个文件

say.text: 把这套下单流程画成流程图
say.note: 按步骤和判断分支布局

say.text: 把这段代码逻辑画成时序图
say.note: 参与者在上,消息自上而下

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude draws dark-themed SVG diagrams on request — architecture, flowchart, sequence, mind map and more — saving one standalone .svg file plus a companion @2x PNG.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever you ask for any technical or conceptual diagram, say "draw me a diagram", or upload content and ask to visualize it.

say_en.text: Draw me an architecture diagram of our microservices
Turn this order flow into a flowchart
say_en.note: Follows your steps and decision branches

say_en.text: Diagram this code logic as a sequence diagram
say_en.note: Actors on top, messages flowing down
